```{r}

# Create combinations_isolated - to create isolated two-patch systems, find how isolated patches can be combined to create them. Store these combinations into combinations_isolated.

combinations_isolated <- NULL
i = 0
for(isolated_two_patch_system_i in isolated_two_patch_systems$system_type){
  
  i = i + 1
  
  ID_green_patches = isolated_two_patch_systems %>%
    filter(system_type == isolated_two_patch_system_i) %>%
    select(green_patch_IDs) %>%
    as.character()
  ID_green_patches = unlist(strsplit(ID_green_patches, ", ")) %>%
    as.double()
  
  ID_blue_patches = isolated_two_patch_systems %>%
    filter(system_type == isolated_two_patch_system_i) %>%
    select(blue_patch_IDs) %>%
    as.character()
  ID_blue_patches = unlist(strsplit(ID_blue_patches, ", ")) %>%
    as.double()
  
  combinations_isolated[[i]] = crossing(ID_green_patches,
                                        ID_blue_patches) %>%
    mutate(system_type = isolated_two_patch_system_i,
           connection = "isolated") %>% #Change this one
    rename(ID_green_patch = ID_green_patches,
           ID_blue_patch = ID_blue_patches) %>%
    mutate(patches_combined = paste0(ID_green_patch, "|", ID_blue_patch)) %>%
    select(system_type,
           connection,
           patches_combined,
           ID_green_patch,
           ID_blue_patch)
  
  expect_equal(nrow(combinations_isolated[[i]]),
             length(ID_green_patches) * length(ID_blue_patches))
}

combinations_isolated = combinations_isolated %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(system_nr = 1000 + row_number())
```

```{r meta-ecosystems-create}

# Create combinations_metaecos - to create meta-ecosystems, find which patches were connected to each other. Store these combinations into combinations_metaecos.

combinations_metaecos = ds_patches %>%
  filter(time_point == 0,
         metaecosystem == "yes") %>%
  select(system_nr,
         metaecosystem_type,
         culture_ID) %>%
  group_by(system_nr,
           metaecosystem_type) %>%
  summarise(ID_green_patch = (mean(culture_ID) - 0.5),
            ID_blue_patch = (mean(culture_ID) + 0.5)) %>%
  rename(system_type = metaecosystem_type) %>%
  mutate(connection = "connected",
         patches_combined = paste0(ID_green_patch, "|", ID_blue_patch)) %>%
  select(system_type,
         connection,
         system_nr,
         patches_combined,
         ID_green_patch,
         ID_blue_patch) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r isolated-and-metaeco-system-join}

# Bind isolated two-patch systems and meta-ecosystems.

combinations_isolated_n_metaecos = rbind(combinations_isolated,
                                         combinations_metaecos)

n_patches_combinations = nrow(combinations_isolated_n_metaecos)

expect_equal(nrow(combinations_isolated_n_metaecos), 
             nrow(combinations_isolated) + nrow(combinations_metaecos))
```
